question.text: Three objects $A, B$ and $C$ are kept in a straight line on a frictionless horizontal surface. These have masses $m, 2 m$ and $m$, respectively. The object $A$ moves towards $B$ with a speed $9 \mathrm{~ms}^{-1}$ and makes an elastic collision with it. Thereafter, $B$ makes completely inelastic collision with $C$. All motions occur on the same straight line. Find the final speed (in $\mathrm{ms}^{-1}$ ) of the object $C$.
